questions.q: In which year did Vision debut in The Avengers #57?
questions.why: Vision's 1968 debut came in The Avengers issue 57, by Roy Thomas and John Buscema.

questions.q: Vision is sometimes classified as what kind of artificial being?
questions.why: Vision is an android; the comics also label that kind of being a synthezoid.

questions.q: Vision's forehead gem absorbs and projects which kind of energy?
questions.why: The forehead gem absorbs and projects solar energy.

questions.q: Whose brain patterns shaped Vision's personality in the comics?
questions.why: Vision's personality is based on Wonder Man's brain patterns.
Vision married Wanda Maximoff, the Scarlet Witch.

questions.q: Which actor plays Vision in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
Which Infinity Stone powers Vision in the MCU?
questions.why: In the MCU the Mind Stone powers Vision.

questions.q: Who built Vision as a weapon against the Avengers?
questions.why: Ultron built Vision, but he turned against his creator and joined the Avengers.

questions.q: Who wrote the acclaimed 2015 Vision series about a suburban android family?
questions.why: Tom King wrote Vision (2015 to 2016), where Vision tries to live a suburban life.

questions.q: Vision's body was built from a copy of which hero's android body?
questions.why: Ultron rebuilt the Golden Age android Human Torch into Vision, using a duplicate of that body.
